'''October 1999 Boca Raton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boca Raton, Florida on 31 October 1999. [[David Irvine]] won it. It is known from Andrew Ledwith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d95">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-05-boca-raton-florida-10-31-99d95/ boca-raton-florida-10-31-99], DeckTech (Andrew "Gadget" Ledwith, 5 November 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-11-05-boca-raton-florida-10-31-99d95/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 31 October 1999
* '''Site:''' Boca Raton, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[David Irvine]]
